title: Capitalist Empire — Map & Graphics Progress
developmentNotice: Released game: v0.29.2. New artwork and features listed as local development are installed locally and remain unpublished.

items.title: GPU map renderer: smooth pan and zoom, no visible redraws
Lot-based towns: streets, sidewalks, invisible slot grid; towns start small and grow
Painting pipeline: engine guides → ChatGPT → 30° tilt check → atlas packing
Build flow: pick a look, choose a highlighted site, construction rises over the build time
Core houses, shops, civic buildings and industry
items.detail: Installed in the main game. The core set now includes the reviewed windmill painting.

items.title: 10 painted resource deposits, clickable across their ground
135 product pictures in the facility panels
No repeated design within a block; every lot gets art that fits it
Front-row buildings face their street
Lane-true traffic with period vehicles that change with the years
13 new animated vehicle sheets; frames aligned so bodies never hop
Motor vehicles drive steadily (no shimmer); horse carts walk
Factory smoke leaves the painted chimney tops
Animated water: fountains, lake and pond ripples and glints
Animated clock hands on clock towers
items.detail: Moving hands on 4 clock faces (two city halls, belfry, Victorian town hall); re-detect after the roof repaints are packed, and teach the detector the smaller shop and post-office clocks.

items.title: One restrained flame at Ateshgah’s central altar
items.detail: Local development: the photo-based temple has one bounded central flame, with game-speed, pause and reduced-motion support. Unpublished.

items.title: Seasonal daylight, dusk and night-time city lighting
items.detail: Released in v0.29.2. A full day takes about 24 minutes at normal speed; Settings can keep constant daylight.

items.title: Windmill sails follow game speed and pause
items.detail: Local development: the reviewed windmill and separate rotating sails are installed and connected to the main renderers. Unpublished.

items.title: Country approaches reach rural facility plots
items.detail: Local development: short approaches connect rural roads to farm and facility boundaries while avoiding other buildings. Unpublished.

items.title: Varied factory smoke with a gentle shared breeze
items.detail: Completed for the next local update: four plume patterns create variety without a physics simulation.

items.title: Curved country roads, rounded kerbs and town roundabouts
items.detail: Completed locally. Traffic follows the curves, while roads keep clear of buildings and water.

items.title: Vehicles face along curves and round roundabouts: diagonal vehicle paintings (8 directions)
All new paintings get roofs that read correctly from the map camera
Repaint 8 flagged buildings (courthouse, post office, bank, police, Art Nouveau store, hotel, apartment block, Deco civic centre without French flags)
Repaint 16 houses and shops whose low roofs look folded backwards
Glass-box check: every painting must fill its own layout box (footprint, walls and height)
Repaint the buildings that ignored their box (department store, New York and London shops and houses, their rear views)
Each city’s own architecture: the complete v4 set
items.detail: Local development: all 117 era and city designs are installed. This completed set is not yet released.

items.title: Later eras: the complete v5 set
items.detail: Local development: all 41 later-era designs are installed, from Deco streets to post-war towers. Unpublished.

items.title: Towns redevelop lot by lot over the decades
Roads of their time: setts in towns, gravel country roads, tarmac in the 1920s, asphalt in the 1930s; farm tracks stay dirt
Real-building pipeline: owner photos → glass-box layout → ChatGPT painting in the game style
Baku’s twin-domed clock building
items.detail: Existing installed main-game landmark artwork.

items.title: Historic landmarks appear in their real years
items.detail: Local development: opening years and protected sites control founding landmarks and later construction. New additions remain unpublished.

items.title: Five signature landmarks for the other cities
items.detail: Local development: New York City Hall, Elizabeth Tower, Birmingham Town Hall, Hôtel Negresco and Tokyo Station are installed. Unpublished.

items.title: Landmarks occupy their own city districts
items.detail: Local development: each installed landmark uses its city, district, plot and opening year. New additions remain unpublished.

items.title: Players can build landmarks as wonders: very expensive (proposal ~$100M), unlocked at ~$100–150M yearly capitalisation with the cash, or funded over time from the budget
AI rivals start rich, so they cannot rush wonders: same unlock rules, no wonders at game start
Wonders draw visitors: more street life and traffic, and more customers for nearby shops (effect sizes as a proposal for sign-off)
Baku’s dense Old City, painted walls and gate traffic
items.detail: Completed locally: more than thirty small houses, distinct artwork, a taller Maiden Tower and traffic through the gates.

items.title: Reviewed Ismailiyya Palace
items.detail: Local development: the selected symmetric palace painting is installed. Unpublished.

items.title: Repaired Flame Towers
items.detail: Local development: the repaired three-tower artwork is installed. Unpublished.

items.title: Photo-based Ateshgah fire temple
items.detail: Local development, installed 25 October: five-sided cell ring, gate with upper guest chamber and open central altar. Unpublished.

items.title: Carved Nizami Street block
items.detail: Local development, installed 25 October: carved oil-boom facade with crowned windows and domed oriels. Unpublished.

items.title: Philharmonic Hall
items.detail: Painting work remains in progress and awaits owner review. Not installed or released.

items.title: Bibi-Heybat Mosque
items.detail: Painting work remains in progress and awaits owner review. Not installed or released.

items.title: Old City courtyard houses
items.detail: Painting work remains in progress and awaits owner review. Not installed or released.

items.title: Rear views for stores, banks and other large buildings
items.detail: Local development: all 20 reviewed rear views are installed, including the final Tokyo and Baku designs. Unpublished.

items.title: Painted construction stages for all three lot sizes
items.detail: Local development: groundworks and frame paintings cover small, rectangular and large lots. Eleven paintings provide complete stage pairs for all three sizes; alternate variants are used only when their pair is complete.

items.title: Show painted stages while buildings go up
items.detail: Local development: the main renderers select groundworks, frame and reveal stages as construction advances. Unpublished.

items.title: Detailed static grass, with the original Low-quality option
items.detail: Completed locally: dimensional grass and clover patches add ground detail. Vegetation stays still, and Low keeps the lighter appearance.

items.title: Denser, taller city cores
items.detail: The dense Baku Old City is complete locally. Further town-centre variety remains in progress.

items.title: Factory artwork matches the product made
items.detail: Local development: related factory silhouettes follow the selected product. This changes appearance only and remains unpublished.

items.title: Vacant lots look intentional, not bare lawn squares
Parked lorries beside reviewed factory loading bays
items.detail: Local development: period lorries stand beside the reviewed loft and later-era factory loading doors. Decorative only; unpublished.

items.title: Fix the long-failing city-plan regression check
Finish the combined local update before release
items.detail: Released game remains v0.29.2. The expanded artwork is installed locally; held paintings, review and balance work remain before a new game release.

items.title: Location choices affect land cost and business
items.detail: Completed for the local update: recorded building sites, local freight and the selected $15,000 centre-land premium.

items.title: Baku's oil fields sit at the edge of town, as the real Bibi-Heybat and Balakhany fields did
High, Low and Custom graphics settings
items.detail: Completed locally. Change quality without reloading the game or moving the camera.

items.title: Vehicle headlights after dark
items.detail: Completed for the next local update, alongside the night-light controls.

items.title: Smoother month-end processing
items.detail: The background month-end work is integrated locally and preserves the economic results.

items.title: Keep one floating tutorial window
items.detail: Completed locally: the original movable tour stays; the additional checklist window is removed.

items.title: Our story, by J.R.
items.detail: The creator’s approved account of how Capitalist Empire began is now on this website.

items.title: Founder strengths and real trade-offs
items.detail: Shared-opening comparisons are complete. Founder-specific openings and individual perks are being evaluated before balance decisions.

items.title: Automated business playtesting
items.detail: Development progress: bounded paid-action and replay checks are complete. Broader business coverage and longer analysis remain in progress.

recent: The complete city-era sets and twenty rear views are installed locally.
Photo-based Ateshgah and the carved Nizami Street block were installed locally on 25 October.
Philharmonic Hall, Bibi-Heybat and courtyard houses remain in progress for owner review.
